articles.summary: What can replace VMware Aria Automation (vRA)? Which tool covers provisioning, configuration, the catalog, orchestration and cost, and what each costs.
articles.title: VMware Aria Automation alternatives, by what each one replaces

articles.summary: Windmill's MCP server now has one URL, /api/mcp, and serves the tools of an AI session. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can explore a workspace, write scripts, flows and apps as your drafts, test-run, diff and deploy them, and run what is deployed. The access chosen at sign-in or on the token decides which tools the client gets.
articles.title: Build and run from your AI client over MCP

articles.summary: Saved AI agents are listed on the home page, created from + New, and run or chatted with from their own page without a flow around them. Anyone who can read an agent can run it, operators included, and it runs as them.
articles.title: Standalone AI agents

articles.summary: Two new toggles in the operator settings of a workspace let operators build flows and full-code apps on top of scripts and flows that are already deployed. Operators still cannot write backend scripts. Each right is granted independently, and granting either one makes the workspace's operators consume a full seat instead of half a seat.
articles.title: Operator builder rights for flows and full-code apps

articles.summary: What do Kubernetes Jobs and CronJobs leave out for multi-step batch pipelines, and how do you add that layer without leaving the cluster?
articles.title: What Kubernetes Jobs and CronJobs don't do for you

articles.summary: How do you keep who can do what, and what runs as whom, on an automation platform reviewable? In Windmill, roles, identity mapping, run-as rules and protection rulesets are YAML in git, applied by CI.
articles.title: Governance for your automation platform, in a git repo

articles.summary: Share a saved AI agent in Slack channels and it answers bot mentions in the thread, for workspace members as themselves or for anyone in the channel as its run-on-behalf-of identity.
articles.title: AI agents answer in Slack

articles.summary: AI agents can now wait for a person without holding a worker. A script, flow or MCP tool can require approval before it runs, and the built-in Ask a question tool lets the agent ask for a choice or missing information, answered from the run page or the chat.
articles.title: Tool approval and questions for AI agents

articles.summary: A new AI decision step asks a decision model, TypeSafe's Jev or Cloudflare's Clef on Workers AI, typed questions about a state and returns calibrated answers instead of text. Route on the answers with a Branch to one that the editor builds from the questions, or give the step to an AI agent as a tool.
articles.title: AI decision flow step

articles.summary: Platform teams are responsible for production. Every other team wants to build its own tools with AI. An AI Session builds internal software with your whole workspace as context, within your permissions, and ships it through your deployment pipeline.
articles.title: Introducing AI Sessions: build internal software with your whole workspace as context

articles.summary: Developer and Operator become default workspace roles, sets of capabilities any workspace can override. Enterprise Edition adds custom roles.
articles.title: Workspace roles

articles.summary: MCP clients that support MCP Apps, such as Claude and ChatGPT, can show Windmill runs, run tables, deploy reviews and workspace items as interactive cards in the conversation, through four new tools on the /api/mcp server.
articles.title: Windmill cards in Claude and ChatGPT
